analysis: SFMC-REQ-046 requires the SFMC software to include spacecraft mission time for every mission-log entry. This is a clear, testable data logging requirement specifying data attributes for recorded events. No writing defects (such as vague criteria or unassigned allocation) are present. It does not represent a safety control, interlock, or safe-state mitigation, so SWE-184 does not apply.
summary: SFMC-REQ-046 is an acceptable data logging requirement that clearly specifies including spacecraft mission time in each mission-log entry.
